title: Provider & Connector Manifest

field_contracts.provider_id: Normalized non-empty identifier; unique within the manifest and joined to ProviderIconRegistry by the same id.
field_contracts.category: One of identity, cloud_storage, ai, developer, creative, payment; must match the linked provider icon category.
field_contracts.capabilities: Non-empty explicit capability set; identity, storage, AI, developer, creative, payment, or health. Capabilities are declarative, not live execution proof.
field_contracts.availability: Explicit deployment/certification state. The shipped standard manifest is UNVERIFIED; PLANNED, AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, UNSUPPORTED_REGION, DEGRADED, and OUTAGE require a separately verified source.
field_contracts.regions: Non-empty explicit region set. GLOBAL is metadata intent only and is not proof of regional reachability.
field_contracts.connector_version: Non-empty version label for the connector contract. manifest-v1 is the local metadata contract, not a deployed connector release.
field_contracts.auth_type: One of OAUTH2_PKCE, API_KEY, OIDC, DEVICE_CODE, LOCAL_BROKER, NONE. No credential is stored by this manifest.
field_contracts.permissions: Non-empty explicit permission set. Standard vocabulary includes account_metadata, provider_connection, usage_metadata, cloud_transfer, backup, billing, novel_workspace, character_workspace, and developer_repository; developer_repository is metadata for developer connectors and does not grant access until certification.
field_contracts.health_endpoint: Optional HTTP(S) URL, default null/UNVERIFIED. A URL never changes availability or proves a healthy connector.

standard_manifest.policy: Icons and planned metadata are not availability. No quota, cost, credential, live health, or certification claim is made.

validation_policy.unknown_provider: return null or StateError via require; never synthesize a connector

application.live_wiring: ProviderConnectorManifest.standard is the single metadata lookup seam derived from ProviderIconRegistry.standard.
application.current_consumer: Domain contract only in step 115.9. Quick Connect tile wiring is reserved for 115.15; connection state transitions are reserved for 115.10.
application.data_source: Bundled local metadata only until a certified deployment/availability source is supplied.

deferred_scope.live_connector_certification: Only CERTIFIED or LIMITED versioned connectors may become connectable under connector_sdk_spec.

evidence_boundary: Local metadata and validation contract for step 115.9 only. It does not claim provider/connector availability, live quota or cost, successful authentication, healthy endpoints, credentials, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, or publication.
